skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop and implement effective sales promotion strategies for businesses and consumers.
Create and evaluate sales promotion plans.
Engage consumers through various sales promotion tools and techniques.
Understand and comply with legal and ethical standards in sales promotion activities.
Integrate sales promotion activities into overall marketing communication strategies.
Analyze market data to inform sales promotion decisions.
Collaborate effectively in group projects and presentations.
Deliver clear and persuasive presentations on sales promotion topics.
